sources.sb2-probe-2026-10: SB2 probe rounds 1 and 2, 2026-10-15/16 (spec section 2); not a public document

notes: Status vocabulary: supported = documented by BFO or NetSuite, or confirmed by an SB2 render; partial = works with a stated condition; unsupported = documented as not implemented, or ignored/failing in the SB2 probe; unverified = not pinned to a fetched source or SB2 render (see note).

BFO's published reference is for Report Generator 1.1.x (userguide 1.1.63). NetSuite's help lists BFO 1.2.10 and FreeMarker 2.3.26 (netsuite-third-party), but the SB2 probe saw FreeMarker 2.3.34, so the doc version numbers lag the engine. BFO claims are 'documented', not 'tested in NetSuite', unless the source is sb2-probe-2026-10.

BFO attributes and CSS properties are the same thing: a style="..." attribute or a <style> rule sets the same names as an XML attribute (userguide, 'Stylesheet definitions'). Attribute pages in bfo-css say 'Used By: All block elements' for most layout attributes; element attribute lists here are expanded from the per-element pages plus their shared attribute pages (border-top-color, margin-left, header-height ...).

effect: every css entry, css value and attribute marked unsupported or partial says what happens. ignored = silently dropped (SB2 probe: flex, grid, border-radius, rem); breaks = fails the render (SB2 probe: position:absolute with no position:relative ancestor); unknown = not tested. Validator mapping: breaks -> ERROR, ignored and unknown -> WARN. Value-level effects live in css[prop].valueEffects[keyword] (values themselves stay plain status strings); use the value effect first, then the entry effect.

Attribute lookup rule: status = elements[el].attributes[attr] // globalAttributes[attr]; if neither has it the status is unknown and the validator WARNs. Attributes of unsupported/partial status carry their effect in elements[el].attributeEffects[attr].
Unverified elements: their attributes are not checked; the element itself gets one WARN.
entitiesNote: The 246 names come from the 'Named Entities' appendix of the BFO userguide (bfo-userguide), which is the table the BFO DTD is built from. amp, lt, gt, quot and apos are the five predefined XML entities, added here as standard XML, not from the BFO table. NetSuite help claims   isn't rendered (netsuite-html4-differences); SB2 shows it is: template 135's header source contains 'Phone: 913-303-4356   Fax', it rendered, and renderAsString kept the entity (sb2-probe-2026-10). Do not rewrite or flag  .

lengthUnits.note: pt, mm, in, em and % appear in BFO's own examples (bfo-userguide, bfo-css width/margin/font-size pages); a bare number means points. px appears in NetSuite's font sample (netsuite-fonts) but BFO's pages do not list it, and the SB2 probe did not test it. rem is ignored (sb2-probe-2026-10). cm and the others were not found in a fetched source.

pdf.note: Document root for a source template. NetSuite converts <pdf> to <html> when a PDF template prints as HTML (netsuite-source-editing). The XML declaration and the -//big.faceless.org//report DOCTYPE come first; HTML5 doctypes are not allowed.

pdfset.note: Wrapper holding several <pdf> documents, used by statement templates (<pdfset><#list statements as statement><pdf>...).

html.note: Not a BFO source element. Merged statement output from render.statement uses <html> as the root of each document inside <pdfset> (SB2 probe round 2); validators for merged XML must accept <pdfset> holding <html> children. In source templates use <pdf>.

head.note: Holds meta, link, style, bookmarklist and macrolist.

body.note: Page defaults: size, margin, header/footer macros with header-height/footer-height, background-macro, pagenumber. Page-break attributes only act on direct children of body. A percentage body width fails with a 'no size specified' error; use an absolute value.

pbr.note: Forces a page break; attributes (size, header, footer, background-macro...) carry to following pages.

macrolist.note: Lives in head; holds macro elements. Header/footer macros need a declared height or they are not applied; a template cannot have several headers.

macro.note: Requires an id; referenced from body/pbr via header, footer or background-macro. Content cannot be bare text.

meta.note: name/value pairs such as title, author.

link.note: Embeds fonts (type="font") or stylesheets (type="stylesheet"). NetSuite templates link the nsfont roots (src="${nsfont.NotoSans_Regular}") with subtype="truetype" or "opentype" and bytes="2"; File Cabinet fonts need subtype="opentype" even for TTF (netsuite-languages-fonts, netsuite-fonts).

style.note: CSS2 stylesheet in head; must not be wrapped in HTML comments. Parse errors in CSS throw instead of being ignored. type="text/css" is accepted: NetSuite stock templates carry it and SB2 template 135 renders with it (sb2-probe-2026-10).

script.note: BFO documents document-level JavaScript; not tested in NetSuite and not expected to be needed.

input.note: BFO form field (text, select, checkbox, radio, button, signature); not tested in NetSuite.

option.note: BFO form option for select inputs; not tested in NetSuite.

object.note: BFO embeds Flash with it (obsolete); not tested in NetSuite.

p.note: General paragraph; anonymous paragraphs are created for bare text directly inside body, li and td but NOT div (text directly in a div did not draw in SB2).

a.note: Link when href is set; href works on any element.

small.note: Font 25% smaller (documented on the big page).

code.note: Typewriter font, no line wrapping. Listed in the userguide text-element table; the tag reference has no page for it, so its attributes follow tt.

symbol.note: Symbol font (documented on the zapf page).

br.note:
Line break. Must be self-closed (
) in the XML. A literal '
' prints as text when a field value contains a line-break character.

table.note: Use table-layout="fixed" with an explicit width for predictable columns; border applies to the whole table (use cellborder for every cell); cellspacing is not supported, use cellmargin. Do not nest a table in a td if it must split across pages.

thead.note: Repeats at the top of every page the table spans; no effect unless the table wraps. At most one per table.

tbody.note: Rows added directly to a table go into an implicit tbody.

tfoot.note: Repeats at the bottom of every page the table spans.

tr.note: Border/padding/margin on a row only apply vertically.

td.note: align/valign on a td set the default for its children, not the cell. Bare text inside a td gets an anonymous paragraph.

th.note: Purely stylistic: treated like td for layout (userguide, Tables). No tag-reference page, so attributes follow td.

ul.note: Unordered list; can split across pages.

ol.note: Ordered list; can split across pages.

li.note: List item; bare text gets an anonymous paragraph.

div.note: Block container. Text directly inside a div is not drawn (SB2 probe): wrap it in p, span or a table cell. position:absolute needs a position:relative parent and cannot be a direct child of body.

img.note: PNG, JPEG, GIF, PBM, PGM, TIFF; size follows dpi unless width/height are set. NetSuite needs an absolute URL on a file that is Available Without Login or Company-Wide Usage (then use <@filecabinet>). Must be self-closed.

barcode.note: codetype, value and showtext are mandatory in NetSuite's docs; height/width are required for qrcode; linear codes ignore width and size from bar-width. NetSuite lists these codetypes: aztec, codabar, code25, code25checksum, code25deutschenpost, code39, code39checksum, code128, databar, datamatrix, deutchepostmatrix, ean8, ean13, upca, intelligentmail, maxicode, pdf417, postnet, qrcode, rm4scc.

pagenumber.note: Current page number; idref prints another element's page. Resolved late, so it cannot be used in FreeMarker declarations. size sets the digit allowance (default 3).

totalpages.note: Total page count; same late-resolution limit as pagenumber.

display.note: BFO documents only block, inline and none. flex and grid are ignored: children stack vertically (SB2 probe). inline-block, table, table-cell and list-item are not documented values.

position.note: absolute is placed relative to its parent and cannot be a child of body. In SB2, absolute on a top-level div or p failed the render (UNEXPECTED_ERROR); inside a position:relative parent it worked. fixed and sticky are not BFO values (use a background-macro for fixed placement).

top.note: Offset for relative and absolute boxes. bottom and right are not used.

left.note: Offset for relative and absolute boxes.

bottom.note: Not used for positioning (userguide, CSS2 differences, 9.4).

right.note: Not used for positioning (userguide, CSS2 differences, 9.4).

z-index.note: Later elements are always drawn over earlier ones (userguide, CSS2 differences, 9.9.1).

float.note: Sets display:inline automatically; text wraps around the box.

clear.note: Attribute page lists left/right; the userguide float section also lists none and both.

overflow.note: Only visible and hidden. Do not nest overflow:hidden deeper than 12 (Acrobat 4) or 28 levels.

visibility.note: hidden keeps the space; display:none removes it.

width.note: Percentages are relative to the containing block; a percentage body width fails (NetSuite).

height.note: Percentages need a containing block with a height.

min-width.note: Not mentioned in the BFO attribute index or the CSS2 differences list.

min-height.note: Not mentioned in the BFO attribute index or the CSS2 differences list.

margin.note: One to four values; also margin-top/right/bottom/left. Transparent. Percentages use the containing block's width.

padding.note: One to four values; also padding-top/right/bottom/left.

box-sizing.note: Not in the BFO attribute index. BFO's width includes margin, border and padding (width attribute page).

border.note: Shorthand: width, style, color. Also border-top/right/bottom/left. On a table, applies to the whole table, not each cell.

border-width.note: A length; per side as border-top-width etc.

border-style.note: double, groove, ridge, inset and outset are not used (userguide, CSS2 differences, 8.5.3).

border-radius.note: Ignored on a div, a table and a td with background (SB2 probe, identical PDF with and without). BFO's own rounded-corner attribute is corner-radius.

corner-radius.note: BFO's rounded-corner attribute (length or percentage of the block width). Not render-tested in SB2.

border-collapse.note: The collapsing border model is not implemented and borders are always drawn around empty cells (userguide, CSS2 differences, 17.6). Whether NetSuite ignores or rejects the property was not tested.

border-spacing.note: Not in the BFO attribute index; use the cellmargin attribute instead of cellspacing.

box-shadow.note: Not in the BFO attribute index; not tested.

opacity.note: Not in the BFO attribute index; not tested.

background-color.note: Named colours from the BFO table, #rgb/#rrggbb.

background-image.note: Works with an absolute, publicly reachable URL (& escaped as &); SB2 probe drew the image behind the div text with background-repeat:no-repeat.

background-repeat.note: no-repeat was used in the SB2 probe and drew the image once; without it the div was empty in that test. Not an attribute in BFO's index (its own control is background-image-position).

background-image-position.note: BFO's own attribute; default stretch. repeat can be slow.

background-position.note: The userguide box-model text says background-position, but the attribute index only has background-image-position; docs conflict, not tested.

background-size.note: Not in the BFO attribute index; not tested.

background.note: Shorthand not in the BFO attribute index; use background-color and background-image.

background-pdf.note: Extended Edition feature of BFO; not tested in NetSuite.

font-family.note: Built-in: Times/serif, Helvetica/sans-serif, Courier/monospace, Symbol, ZapfDingbats, plus the CJK names. Other fonts need a <link type="font"> (NetSuite templates use the nsfont root). A list means per-character fallback, not first-installed.

font-size.note: Lengths in pt, mm, em, %, or named sizes (medium = 11pt). rem is ignored (SB2 probe).

font-weight.note: BFO recognises only normal and bold; numeric weights are not documented.

font-style.note: outline and filled are BFO additions.

font-variant.note: small-caps is synthesised and slow on long text.

font.note: Shorthand: style weight variant size/line-height family.

line-height.note: normal, a length or a percentage of font-size.

word-spacing.note: Not used; see justification-ratio (userguide, CSS2 differences, 16.5).

text-align.note: Default is justify in most locales. The align attribute is the HTML-compatible form.

text-decoration.note: overline and blink are not valid (userguide, CSS2 differences, 16.3).

vertical-align.note: On block elements only top/middle/bottom act. valign is a synonym; on a td it sets the default for its children.

white-space.note: forced is a BFO addition; whitespace (no hyphen) is a synonym.

table-layout.note: fixed needs an explicit table width, otherwise BFO falls back to auto.

page-break-before.note: Only recognised on direct children of body (tr also accepts join). Use <pbr/> for explicit page breaks.

page-break-after.note: Only recognised on direct children of body.

page-break-inside.note: Only recognised on direct children of body; only table, ul, ol, p, pre, h1-h4 and blockquote can split across pages.

orphans.note: Text blocks; default 2. widows is the pair.

size.note: Page size on body/pbr/#pageN: A4, letter, legal, A4-landscape ... or width/height (userguide lists the names).

list-style-type.note: BFO's own attribute is marker-type; list-style-type was not found in a fetched source.

marker-type.note: disc, middle-dot, decimal, lower-roman, upper-roman, lower-alpha, upper-alpha, circled-number and others on ul/ol.

transform.note: Not in the BFO attribute index; use rotate. Not tested.

transition.note: Not applicable to PDF; not tested.

cursor.note: Not applicable to PDF; not tested.

content.note: Generated content is handled differently in BFO (userguide, CSS2 differences, 12).

@import.note: At-rules (@import, @charset) are not supported (userguide, CSS2 differences, 4.1.5); load stylesheets with <link type="stylesheet">.

@media.note: Media types are not used; there is only one medium, PDF (userguide, CSS2 differences, 7).

@page.note: The @page rule is not used; set size and margins on body/pbr (userguide, CSS2 differences, 13.1).

selectors.note: BFO uses only :lang, :first-child and the custom :last-child pseudo selectors (userguide, CSS2 differences, 5.11); CSS parse errors throw instead of being skipped (4.2).

netsuiteCaveats.text: NetSuite help claims   isn't rendered; SB2 shows it is (template 135 header, rendered PDF and merged XML kept it). Leave   alone.
cellspacing is not supported; use cellmargin. A percentage body width fails with a 'no size specified' error.

Elements must be closed, attributes quoted, and empty elements self-closed (
). No HTML5 declarations.
Header and footer macros need a declared height or they are not applied; only one header per template.
<pagenumber/> and <totalpages/> cannot be used inside FreeMarker declarations.
Only table, ul, p, pre, ol, h1-h4 and blockquote split across pages; a table inside a td is cut off at the page bottom.
Files used in templates need Available Without Login or Company-Wide Usage (then use the <@filecabinet> directive).

Text directly inside a
is not drawn; wrap it in

, or a table cell.
position:absolute with no position:relative ancestor failed the render with UNEXPECTED_ERROR.
display:flex, display:grid, border-radius and rem units are silently ignored.

freemarker.note: Names come from the FreeMarker manual's alphabetical indexes (NetSuite runs 2.3.34 per the SB2 probe; its help lists 2.3.26). is_* and iso_* variants were expanded from the expert and date built-in pages, truncate_* and json_string/url_path from the string page. The index pages are the only source for names like switch and with_args: they were not render-tested. default, exists, if_exists and web_safe are deprecated but still valid (freemarker-deprecated-builtins); ?exists appears in a real SB2 template.

nbsp.note: Rendered in SB2 (template 135, 41,318-byte PDF); merged renderAsString output kept the entity. Contradicts NetSuite help's claim that it isn't rendered.
